meta.name: cyber
meta.description: Expert cybernetic portfolio: void-black surfaces, cyan/magenta neon accents, glass chrome, compact Inter + JetBrains Mono, icon-grid skills, CSS grid/scanline background (no Three.js).

primary.role: Primary blue for CTAs and mid brand gradient

secondary.role: Magenta secondary for neon terminals and brand gradient end

accent.role: Cyan accent for borders, focus, icons, and glow

neutral.usage: Lightest (#E8EEF7) primary text; slate mid for secondary; void stack for bg/surfaces

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast light text on void black with cyan/magenta neon accents and glass borders

typography.font_style_notes: Compact expert type — hero max ~2.15rem; mono for kickers, tech tags, brand mark

spacing.section_rhythm: Sections ~56px padding (44px mobile); max content width 1120px; nav height 56px

layout.grid_system: CSS grid primary; skills 4-col icon grid; projects 2-col; experience stacked rails
layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned copy with centered mobile hero; section kickers + titles

shape.border_usage: 1px slate glass borders; cyan-strong on hover/active; 1px brand gradient hairline on cards
shape.divider_style: Hairline borders; experience left accent rail on hover; footer gradient tick

elevation.depth_cues: glass blur cards over CSS radial/grid/scanline void background

iconography.style: react-icons (Fa/Si/Hi2) — flat brand-colored skill glyphs + outline nav icons
iconography.preferred_set: react-icons: FaReact FaNodeJs FaGitAlt FaPython SiAngular SiDjango SiTypescript SiMysql Hi2 nav

motion.entrance_pattern: hover translateY/X only — no floating particle chips
motion.philosophy: minimal functional micro-motion; ambient CSS background only

components.button_style: Compact pill CTAs with cyan→blue gradient; ghost pills with glass border
components.input_style: Elevated dark fields, 10px radius, cyan focus ring
components.card_style: Glass surface rgba(15,23,42,0.72), 14px radius, brand top hairline, hover glow
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed 56px glass bar; icon+label links (icon-only mid breakpoints); AP brand mark; Connect pill
components.list_style: Dense experience glass cards with cyan left rail on hover; skill icon cards 4-col
components.component_notes: Skills are icon cards not hr bars; no floating letter chips; certificates compact hover overlay grid

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Glass command deck over void grid — technical, not synthwave kitsch

visual_language.whitespace_usage: tighter expert density with breathing section gaps
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: light glass UI over soft CSS ambient field
visual_language.focal_strategy: compact hero name + portrait ring, then numbered section kickers
visual_language.texture_usage: CSS radial washes + perspective grid + low-opacity scanlines

composition.hierarchy_method: compact type scale + gradient titles + mono kickers
composition.balance_type: asymmetric hero (copy/portrait) with centered section shells
composition.grouping_strategy: icon skill grid; dense project/experience cards
composition.negative_space_role: void frames glowing chrome; grid fades at edges

imagery.photo_treatment: circular hero portrait with brand-gradient ring + dashed orbit; about rounded frame
imagery.graphic_elements: gradient text, mono chips, icon cards, tech tags, glass borders
imagery.image_shape: circle hero; rounded cards for about/projects/certs

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct (Get in touch / View projects / Connect)

overview.fallback_strategy: static void background if backdrop-filter unsupported

background_effects.description: Fixed void field with cyan/magenta/blue radials, masked cyber grid, subtle scanlines

particle_systems.description: Removed floating tech chips and R3F particles

text_effects.description: Section titles and name accent use CSS background-clip gradient

visual_effects.composite_notes: Rebuild replaces heavy R3F neural field with lightweight CSS cyber background. Navbar is new glass icon+label bar. Skills are 8 react-icons cards (React Angular Node Django Python TypeScript Git MySQL). No floating letter chips. Compact type hero ≤2.15rem. Certificates retained as secondary grid.
